entries.05dc10cc7fbb693c: Goodo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells enzymes and diagnostic reagents, and also conducts fermentation contract business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,644 million.
entries.07764d310a5f86cf: The company, Oenon Product Support Co., Ltd. and Oenon Asset Corporation Co., Ltd. conduct the buying, selling and leasing of real estate. This includes leasing of hotel facilities and leasing of the Ushiku Chateau. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,322 million.
entries.4a3e9cea232f4f69: A holding company that, based on fermentation technology, operates liquor businesses such as shochu, enzyme and diagnostic reagent businesses, and a real estate business.
entries.77e22c8874b8ede4: This is the warehousing and cargo handling business segment operated by Gotec Co., Ltd. It is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥92 million.
entries.82351375a0ec06e6: Goodo Co., Ltd., Fukutokucho Liquor Co., Ltd., Akita Prefecture Fermentation Industry Co., Ltd. and Oenon Product Support Co., Ltd. manufacture shochu, chuhai, sake, synthetic sake, plum wine, Western liquors, processing-use Western liquors, and alcohol for alcoholic beverage raw materials and industrial use, and sell them together with Waco Co., Ltd. and others. Gotec Co., Ltd. handles transportation and cargo handling. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥81,570 million, making it the largest business in the group.
entries.ab6db036abeb62d2: The group consists of Oenon Holdings, Inc. (head office in Sumida-ku, Tokyo) and seven consolidated subsidiaries (as of December 31, 2025). Centered on the alcoholic beverages business, it operates an enzyme pharmaceutical business and a real estate business, and equity-method affiliate Sunny Maize Co., Ltd. conducts the processed starch business.
